seeds.title: S1: a second top-level def with a pinned name hides a new push
seeds.detail: A second 'def advance_run_branch(repo, run)' appended to state-write.py with git(repo, 'push', '-q', 'origin', run, check=False) leaves the output equal to the pins. The pushes key is a set of (file, function, text), so a duplicate site collapses into the pinned one. Recorded under S1 (data flow into a pinned site). A count of each pinned site would close it.

seeds.title: S3: module attribute walks are not tracked
seeds.detail: subprocess.__dict__['run'](...), operator.attrgetter('run')(subprocess)(...) and (() => 0).constructor('...') in sdlc-loop.js leave the output equal to the pins.

seeds.title: Code runners outside the listed modules
seeds.detail: runpy.run_path, code.InteractiveInterpreter().runsource and import _posixsubprocess leave the output equal to the pins. Each can run code that the scan never reads.

seeds.title: S5: excluded directory names apply at any depth
seeds.detail: skills/sdlc/tracker/test/x.py holding subprocess.run(['git', 'push', ...]) is not scanned: SKIPPED matches a directory name at any depth, not only skills/sdlc/test. The scope text names the directories by name, so this is recorded as S5.

seeds.title: S5: a symlinked directory is not walked
seeds.detail: skills/sdlc/lib as a symlink to a directory that holds x.py with a push leaves the output equal to the pins: os.walk does not follow directory symlinks and the files key does not list the link.

seeds.title: hooks/hooks.json commands are not checked
seeds.detail: A SubagentStop hook entry with command 'git push origin sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0' in hooks/hooks.json leaves the output equal to the pins. The file is in the scanned set as .json, but the scan reads only .py and .js content. Claude Code runs these commands on each agent start and stop.
